scope: Proposition 7.2 (Specified defective cells) of the manuscript “A density-uniform condensate bound for dilute Bose gases” (preprints/A-density-uniform-condensate-bound-for-dilute-Bose-gases-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 267 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5dceb5d5d293d6dc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Choose D and ε so that Cv P j≥0 D3 j e−κD2 j ≤ 10−4b−ε in (17). Then choose ζ > 0 sufficiently small in terms of these fixed constants, followed by C0 > ∆A sufficiently large. For small enough density, there is qcl = qcl(ρ) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 such that every collection U of specified cells satisfies Pcl(every cell of U is defective) ≤ q |U| cl . (22) The bound and the convergence of qcl are uniform in the allowed temperatures and sufficiently large volumes. Increasing C0 preserves the statement.
